text: The net ATP from substrate-level phosphorylation in glycolysis is 2 per glucose and 3 per glucosyl unit from glycogen. Glucose spends 2 ATP in the investment phase and the payoff phase makes 4 ATP, while glycogenolysis to glucose-6-phosphate spends only the 1 ATP at phosphofructokinase, so the payoff of 4 ATP leaves a net of 3. CONFIDENCE: 92
